checks: Missing/malformed/query-only links never submit; URL is scrubbed, feedback focused and reset response is no-store/no-referrer/noindex.
Canonical token is memory-only and not consumed on opening; raw password policy, length, confirmation, focus and independent visibility controls are enforced before POST.

Real existing API consumes token, preserves exact password including spaces, revokes sessions and clears cookie; focused success clears fields and returns explicitly to sign-in without auto-login or queued mail.
Used and expired valid-looking credentials produce the same invalid-link UI on submission; expiry failure does not change the password.
Reload/back/cache restoration loses sensitive state safely; reopening the original unconsumed email fragment works, with empty password fields.
Pending fence prevents duplicate submissions, disables fields/toggles, and maps a refused request to focused safe feedback without raw error text.
Network/503/unreadable-success responses clear fields and token, explain uncertainty and offer sign-in/new-link actions with no replay.
Real reset committed behind a deliberately lost response: timeout shows uncertainty, never claims failure/unchanged password and performs exactly one browser submission.
Light/dark, 1440/390/320px, keyboard visibility toggles and reduced motion; no horizontal overflow, browser exceptions, credential URLs/DOM/storage/history/console/server logs or outbound email jobs.
